name: J Trust Co., Ltd.
summary: J Trust Co., Ltd. engages in the provision of various financial services in Japan, South Korea, and Southeast Asia. It engages in the credit guarantee; finance business for consumers and businesses; debt collection business; securities; credit card; individual credit purchase mediation; banking; consulting; real estate; investment; rent guarantee; holding; and system development businesses. J Trust Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1977 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.
